description: The finite saturation step retains old pairs and adds reflexive, reversed, transitive and root-congruent pairs whose endpoints lie in \(S\).
signature:
Lemmatheca.MathematicalLogic.GroundEquality.step.{u, v} {L : FirstOrder.Language}
  [(n : ℕ) → DecidableEq (L.Functions n)] (S : Finset (Lemmatheca.MathematicalLogic.GroundEquality.GroundTerm L))
  (R : Finset (Lemmatheca.MathematicalLogic.GroundEquality.TermPair L)) :
  Finset (Lemmatheca.MathematicalLogic.GroundEquality.TermPair L)
